CORRIGENDUM for the Tender Notice-3
Thursday, 16 June 2016
6883 Hits
CORRIGENDUM / Extension of last date of submission of Tender Notice - 3 (2016-17) With reference to Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram Tender Notice - 3 (2016-17) published in Indian Express & Loksatta news papers on dated 7th June 2016, the last date for the work mentioned may be read as 30th June, 2016 up to 1.00 pm. The remaining terms of the tender will remain the same.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
